source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 5f57dbbfb0043baf9eda32345add7c9bddcf797a patch removes 12 packaged caption SVG variants and replaces their image rendering with inherited before content from Segoe Fluent Icons and Segoe MDL2 Assets fallback. Font sizing uses round(10px, env(hairline)). The native toolbarbuttons retain their actions, titlebar-btn roles and localized tooltip IDs; their default window-button appearance metadata also remains despite appearance:none. The pseudo-element handles RTL mirroring and inactive opacity, and each button has a separate contrast glyph. Historical contrast colors require root:not(lwtheme); the fixed messenger.css block has no root guard, a later difference. At separately pinned Gecko revision 00aad09a820405643aebd693e60a3333ccf04544, the display-list helper uses default appearance to record native window-button rectangles, but its comm pairing and actual Windows behavior are unverified. No font availability, scale, contrast, keyboard, accessible-name, native Snap Layout or runtime test ran.
title: Windows caption glyphs keep native window-button metadata after SVG removal
